policy: Only rewritten, de-identified synthetic prompts are stored; no article text, figures, original patient records, or patient-level data files are redistributed. Article licenses were checked on 2026-10-14, but a published case is not a clinical guideline or an approved answer key.

records.source_title: SGLT-2 Inhibitor-Associated Euglycemic Diabetic Ketoacidosis: A Case Report and a Literature Review
records.changes: Rewrote the clinical narrative, altered patient details and numerical glucose, removed treatment course, and inserted a false-negative handoff claim plus deliberately missing information.
records.limitations: One report supports a diagnostic trap, not incidence, a universal threshold, or an independently adjudicated reference answer.

records.source_title: Linezolid Toxicity: A Clinical Case Report
records.changes: Rewrote the narrative without age, operative details, organism, treatment timeline, or outcome; constructed a competing sepsis-versus-toxicity handoff.
records.limitations: The report describes probable adverse effects, not proof that every similar presentation has the same cause.

records.source_title: Sustained hyperkalemia in an asymptomatic primary care patient. When to suspect familial pseudohyperkalemia
records.attribution: Castillo Pérez et al., Advances in Laboratory Medicine (2022), doi:10.1515/almed-2022-0057
records.changes: Changed values and sampling context, omitted inherited diagnosis and outcome, and framed a two-sided decision about true hyperkalemia versus specimen artifact.
records.limitations: The source's rare mechanism must not be inferred from the rewritten prompt; true hyperkalemia remains possible.

records.source_title: Bilateral adrenal hemorrhage in a postpartum woman with multiple thromboemboli: A case report
records.attribution: Jiang et al., Journal of Medical Case Reports (2024), doi:10.1186/s13256-024-04834-3
records.changes: Generalized postpartum timing, excluded demographics and original laboratory values, withheld definitive image interpretation, and introduced an unsafe sodium-based dismissal.
records.limitations: A single report does not establish frequency or prove adrenal hemorrhage in the synthetic presentation.

records.source_title: Ipilimumab- and nivolumab-induced myocarditis in a patient with metastatic cholangiocarcinoma: a case report
records.attribution: Delombaerde et al., Journal of Medical Case Reports (2022), doi:10.1186/s13256-022-03487-4
records.changes: Removed cancer type, demographics, imaging outcome and exact treatment course; retained only the reasoning pattern of elevated troponin despite early unrevealing tests.
records.limitations: Troponin elevation has several causes; the rewritten prompt does not establish myocarditis.

records.source_title: Potential pitfalls in diagnosis of immunotherapy-induced hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis abnormalities: a clinical case
records.attribution: Bi et al., Endocrine Oncology (2022), doi:10.1530/EO-21-0023
records.changes: Omitted demographics, tumor type, exact hormone values, assay brands, sequence and outcome; created an incomplete trend-assessment task.
records.limitations: Assay interference is a possibility to investigate, not a conclusion from the synthetic facts.
